# Vendored spike libraries

These files are vendored **only** for the standalone aim-lab spike. They are not production
dependencies and should be removed or replaced by a reviewed dependency when the aiming approach is
chosen.

| File | Package/version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.mjs` | `qrcode-generator@2.0.4` | MIT | https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator |
| `jsQR.js` | `jsqr@1.4.0` | Apache-2.0 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr |

- `qrcode-generator` copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase; MIT text in `qrcode.LICENSE.txt`.
- `jsQR` copyright its contributors; Apache-2.0 text in `jsQR.LICENSE`.
